english.title: Cause / permit a vehicle to cause an obstruction / wait where it was likely to cause danger at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the person in charge of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

it to stand at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) on a road, to which the road traffic enactments do not apply, at Stansted Airport London so as to

(C)_[cause an obstruction]_
(D)_[be likely to cause danger]_

to an aircraft, person or property
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5(4) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a person in charge of a vehicle
at a location on a road
to which the road traffic enactments do not apply
at Stansted Airport London
so as to cause / permit the vehicle
to stand so as to cause
an obstruction / be likely to cause danger
to an aircraft / person / property

english.notes: This Byelaw applies to any part of the Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply.
